name: std::unsigned_integral
intro: The concept unsigned_integral<T> is satisfied if and only if T is an integral type and std::is_signed_v<T> is false.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: unsigned_integral<T> may be satisfied by a type that is not an unsigned integer type, for example, bool.

examples.output:
(42) is a signed integral
0xFULL (15) is an unsigned integral
(A) is a signed integral
true (1) is an unsigned integral
4e-2 (0.04) is non-integral
(∫∫) is non-integral
